faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) for filling academic positions on a contract basis in Kochi, Kerala.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post announced under this notification?
faq.answer: The position advertised is Assistant Professor (on Contract basis) in Forensic Science under the School of Environmental Studies.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Assistant Professor (on Contract basis)-Forensic Science position as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for CUSAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting both the online application and the hard copy of the application form is 24 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Forensic Science with at least 55% marks along with a valid NET qualification or a Ph.D degree.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered to selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates with a Ph.D will receive ₹ 47,000/- per month, whereas other eligible contract teachers will be paid ₹ 45,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How much is the application fee for General candidates?
faq.answer: General category candidates are required to pay an application fee amounting to ₹ 950/- as outlined in the notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee relaxation for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, SC/ST candidates have a reduced application fee structure and are required to pay only ₹ 195/- for their submission.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through the online mode by visiting the official portal recruit.cusat.ac.in and subsequently mailing the hard copy.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the printed hard copy of the application be sent?
faq.answer: The printed application along with required enclosures must be sent to The Registrar, Cochin University of Science & Technology, Kochi - 682 022.
